where: Native Harness build on the Mac
what: The native app cannot currently be validated with installed Blaze: the workspace-pinned 0.20261105.4 rejects artifact="gpu" as requiring bindeps; installed dev Blaze --ignore-pin exits at its 95 GiB ceiling while checking harness-native.
cost: Native UI compile, scene tests and replacement app launch are blocked.
cause: The pinned release predates the workspace GPU manifest support; the newer installed compiler reports excessive memory before check completion.
whys: Native Harness uses a GPU artifact dependency.
Its workspace still pins a Blaze release that refuses that dependency.
The available dev compiler exits at its memory ceiling before it can validate the workspace.
class: A consumer workspace depends on compiler features unavailable in its pinned release, without a passing consumer build gate.
prevention: Need a native Harness compile/scene gate with its pinned compiler, plus a pin to a release that passes it; currently blocked by the available compiler.
workaround: Andrew explicitly authorized Cargo. Native app built with pinned Cargo in a clean target, an ordinary host shader dependency in a temporary manifest, and existing Metal source rebound to current per-entry Rust slots; manifest restored after every command. 82 native tests, 15 search tests, 38 shader tests passed; offscreen search and external view inspected; updated window launched.
fix: Pending a working Blaze build for the GPU workspace.
state: open: Blaze build issues remain; native UI compiled and launched with authorized Cargo build
